caption: The drawing depicts a tall grandfather clock with a wooden case colored in rich brown tones, featuring subtle grain patterns and lighter inlays or trim accentuating the borders and corners. The clock has a rectangular base with bracket feet, a long central column with a panel door, and an upper section housing the clock face, which is square with a rounded arch at the top. The clock face itself is white with black Roman numerals and black hands, with an additional smaller dial positioned above the main clock face. The uppermost part of the clock is ornamented with a curved pediment and three finials, each topped with a pointed structure. Decorative gold details are visible on the pediment and the corners. The background of the drawing is plain and off-white, providing contrast to the detailed and colored depiction of the clock.
title: Tall Clock
